# Glossary {#sec-glossary-system-design}

Every notion this tutorial defines, in alphabetical order, with its definition and chapter. The list grows as the
chapters are written.

## A

- **Architectural characteristic**: @def-architectural-characteristic (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)
- **Authentication and authorisation** (credentials, sessions, bearer tokens, JSON Web Tokens):
  @def-auth-session-token (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Availability** (with downtime, nines, error budget, SLO and SLA): @def-availability
  (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)

## B

- **Block, file and object storage** (blocks, files and directories, network-attached storage, buckets and keys,
  distributed file system, chunks and master): @def-storage-kinds (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **Bloom filter false-positive rate** (probability of a zero bit, optimal number of hash functions, bits per key):
  @prp-bloom-false-positive (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **B-tree height** (minimum degree, pages read per lookup): @prp-btree-height (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **Byzantine faults and Byzantine quorums** (equivocation, $3f + 1$ replicas, vouched-for values): @def-byzantine
  (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)

## C

- **CAP properties and PACELC** (atomic consistency, availability, partitions, CP and AP): @def-cap (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **CAP theorem** (asynchronous and partially synchronous models): @thm-cap (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Collisions of random identifiers** (birthday bounds, bits needed, structured identifiers): @prp-id-collision
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Consensus and replicated state machines** (agreement, validity, termination, crash faults): @def-consensus (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Consensus quorums** (majorities, $2f + 1$ processes, FLP): @prp-consensus-quorums (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Consistency models** (linearisable, sequential, causal, eventual, session guarantees): @def-consistency-models
  (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Consistent hashing** (keys moved by modular and consistent hashing, largest share, virtual nodes): @thm-consistent-hashing
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Content delivery network** (edge servers, cache key, freshness lifetime, hit ratio, purge and versioning):
  @def-cdn (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Coordination services** (locks, sessions, leases, fencing tokens, lock-delay): @def-coordination (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)

## D

- **Data model** (relational, key-value, document, wide-column and graph; access patterns): @def-data-model
  (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **Design process**: @def-design-process (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)

## E

- **Erlang C formula** (the M/M/c queue, probability of waiting, mean wait): @thm-erlang-c
  (@sec-performance-and-queueing)
- **Exponential distribution and Poisson process** (no memory, competition, Erlang arrival times, Poisson counts):
  @def-poisson-process (@sec-performance-and-queueing)

## F

- **Failover** (writes lost, semi-synchronous acknowledgement, choosing the follower to promote): @prp-failover-loss
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Failure detectors and gossip membership** (completeness, accuracy, heartbeats, timeouts, seeds): @def-failure-detector
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Functional dependencies and normal forms** (keys, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, decomposition, denormalisation):
  @def-normal-forms (@sec-storage-and-databases)

## H

- **Happens-before, logical clocks and version vectors** (concurrency, Lamport and vector clocks, LWW, CRDTs):
  @def-happens-before (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Heartbeat detector** (detection time, false suspicions, choice of timeout): @prp-heartbeat-detector
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)

## I

- **Identifier schemes** (auto-increment, ticket server, stride, UUID versions 4 and 7, Snowflake): @def-unique-id
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Index, B-tree, LSM tree and Bloom filter** (covering index, memtable, SSTable, tombstone, compaction):
  @def-storage-engine (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **Interface of a web service** (REST, RPC and GraphQL; safe and idempotent operations, idempotency keys, pagination,
  backward compatibility and versions): @def-web-api (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Inverted index** (analyser, posting lists, Boolean and phrase queries, tf-idf): @def-inverted-index
  (@sec-storage-and-databases)

## L

- **Leader-follower replication** (replication log, synchronous and asynchronous replication, lag, read-after-write, failover):
  @def-leader-follower (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Leases, fencing tokens and lock-delay, safety of**: @prp-lease-fencing (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Linearisability, consequences of** (sequential consistency, reads after completed writes): @prp-linearisability (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Little's law**: @thm-littles-law (@sec-performance-and-queueing)
- **Load balancer** (layer 4 and layer 7, assignment rules, health checks, global load balancing): @def-load-balancer
  (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Load estimate**: @def-load-estimate (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)
- **Logical and vector clocks** (clock condition, exact characterisation of happens-before): @thm-logical-clocks
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Lossless decomposition** (Heath's theorem, spurious rows): @prp-lossless-decomposition (@sec-storage-and-databases)

## M

- **M/M/1 queue** (stationary law, mean and distribution of the response time): @thm-mm1 (@sec-performance-and-queueing)
- **Multi-leader and leaderless replication** (quorums, read repair, sloppy quorums, hinted handoff, Merkle trees):
  @def-quorum-replication (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)

## O

- **OAuth 2.0 authorisation-code grant** (roles, PKCE, access and refresh tokens; OpenID Connect and the ID token):
  @def-oauth-authorization-code (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Open and closed systems** (think time, service demands, bottleneck, load test, knee): @def-open-closed-system
  (@sec-performance-and-queueing)
- **Operational bounds** (utilisation law, response time law, bottleneck bound, knee population): @prp-operational-bounds
  (@sec-performance-and-queueing)

## P

- **Partitioning schemes** (range, hash and consistent hashing, virtual nodes, rebalancing, hot keys): @def-partitioning
  (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Paxos** (proposers, acceptors, learners, two phases, Multi-Paxos): @def-paxos (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Paxos safety** (P2c, P2b, one chosen value): @thm-paxos-safety (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)

## Q

- **Quantile estimate from order statistics** (distribution-free intervals, samples needed for a percentile):
  @prp-quantile-estimate (@sec-performance-and-queueing)
- **Quorum intersection** ($R + W > N$, probability of a stale read): @thm-quorum-intersection (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)

## R

- **Raft** (terms, elections, log replication, commitment): @def-raft (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Raft safety** (election safety, log matching, leader completeness, state machine safety): @thm-raft-safety
  (@sec-consistency-and-consensus)
- **Real-time delivery** (short and long polling, server-sent events, WebSocket, heartbeats): @def-real-time-delivery
  (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Request path** (DNS, TCP, TLS and HTTP; round-trip time, intermediaries): @def-request-path (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Response time, throughput, percentiles and utilisation** (empirical quantile, tail latency, capacity):
  @def-response-time (@sec-performance-and-queueing)
- **Requirements specification** (functional and non-functional requirements, workload assumptions):
  @def-requirements-specification (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)

## S

- **Secondary indexes and request routing** (local and global indexes, scatter-gather, partition maps, location
  hierarchies): @def-request-routing (@sec-replication-and-partitioning)
- **Serialisability and two-phase locking** (precedence graph, lock points): @prp-serializability
  (@sec-storage-and-databases)
- **Stateless service** (session state, sticky sessions, session replication; vertical, horizontal and automatic
  scaling): @def-stateless-service (@sec-the-web-stack)

## T

- **Total cost of ownership** (capital and operating expenses, unit cost): @def-total-cost-of-ownership
  (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)
- **Transactions and isolation levels** (ACID, schedules, conflicts, anomalies, snapshot isolation, two-phase locking,
  optimistic control): @def-transaction-isolation (@sec-storage-and-databases)
